Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Driver Service Outsourcing (Mandays Based) 1. Identification and Residential Proof · Identity Criteria: The deployed driver(s) must be a resident of the State of Gujarat. To verify this, th e bidder must mandatorily submit the following documents of the driver(s) prior to official deployment: · Valid Driving License (DL): Issued by a competent Regional Transport Office (RTO) within the Stat e of Gujarat. · Aadhaar Card: Displaying a valid residential address registered within Gujarat. · Voter ID Card: Registered within the electoral jurisdiction of the State of Gujarat. · Police Verification Certificate from the local police station office of Gandhinagar. 2. Driving Experience and Regional Knowledge & Decorum. · License Validity: The driver must hold a valid, active commercial/transport Light Motor Vehicle (LMV ) Driving License.

· Terrain Knowledge: The driver must possess comprehensive knowledge of all Gujarat terrains (incl uding national/state highways, rural pathways, and complex urban corridors). · Local Twin-City Navigation: The driver must have exceptional familiarity with local routes, govern ment institutional complexes, VIP transit zones, and traffic patterns inside the Gandhinagar and Ahmed abad Municipal Corporation (AMC) areas. · Drive must be in proper uniform ( Mention uniform attach photos) 3. On-Demand Deployment Model (Mandays Basis) · Variable Deployment: This contract is strictly executed on a Mandays Basis. The buyer department does not guarantee permanent or continuous monthly employment for a fixed number of personnel. · Minimum Requirement: The baseline operational deployment will start from a minimum of 01 (one) driver. · Callout Notice: The service provider must deploy the driver(s) as and when required by this office u pon receiving an official notification (via telephonic call, official email, or written intimation). The workf orce scale can adjust dynamically up or down according to the immediate operational needs of the dep artment. 4. Outstation and Night Halt Charges · Outstation Coverage: In the event that a driver is directed to travel outside the Ahmedabad Munici pal Corporation (AMC) and Gandhinagar municipal limits, or if an overnight stay (night halt) is required for official departmental duty, an outstation allowance will apply. · Rate and Duration: This office will process a fixed charge of Rs 800 (Rupees Eight Hundred Only) p er block of 8 hours for such outstation duties or night halts. This will include both lodging and boarding . · Billing Claim: These charges will be calculated over and above the standard local daily wage rate a nd must be explicitly claimed in the monthly invoice backed by verified logbook entries showing outsta tion travel details. 5. Payment Terms · Actual Utilization Payment: The final financial disbursement will be calculated and processed stric tly on an actual usage basis (exact number of days the driver(s) performed active duties). · No Idle Charges: No separate payments, retention fees, or idle charges will be disbursed by the buy er for days when no driver service was requested or utilized. · Attendance Log: The bidding agency must maintain a strict, daily updated logbook/attendance she et counter-signed by the controlling officer of the consignee location to enable seamless monthly bill pr ocessing. 6. Bidder Statutory and Support Eligibility · Local Office Footprint: The bidding firm must possess a registered local office or functional operati onal hub within Gujarat (preferably Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar area) to ensure swift logistical alignment , quick administrative coordination, and immediate replacement drivers within short notice. Municipa l Corporation Certificate (The firms should have their offices either in Gandhinagar or Ahm edabad). · Statutory Compliance: The service provider must be fully compliant with all governing statutory no rms including EPF, ESIC, and GST regulations. Valid certificates and recent contribution challans must b e furnished upon request.
